predictedBugs: next-env.d.ts is gitignored but required at build time — Next.js regenerates it automatically, so safe.
CI build step could fail if a future page imports @supabase/ssr without env vars — mitigated by injecting placeholder URLs in the CI workflow.
Husky pre-commit hook runs `npm test` (full vitest) — slow tests in the future could block commits. Acceptable for bootstrap; team can scope down later.
edgeCases: Developer running on Node <20 — package.json does not pin engines; README documents 20.x as the minimum supported version.
Empty `lib/auth/` and `lib/brands/` directories — `.gitkeep` files ensure they survive git operations until stories 1.3/2.2 populate them.
Vitest config tries to load Tailwind v4 PostCSS config (a plugin name as string) and fails — fixed by setting `css.postcss: { plugins: [] }` in vitest.config.ts.
